newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU welcomes first meeting of Bosnia presidency.
newsitem.headline: EU welcomes first meeting of Bosnia presidency.

text.p: EU President Ireland welcomed the first meeting of the collective presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina on Wednesday and said it had a chance to secure peace.

Ireland, on behalf of the 15-nation European Union, urged the new presidency to work together to ensure the structures of the state were established and that there was a smooth transition of authority from existing caretaker structures.
"A most immediate task will be the nomination of the chair of the council of ministers," the EU statement said.
The historic first meeting of Bosnia's three-man presidency ended on Monday after almost four hours of talks in a motel on the outskirts of Sarajevo.
Among issues agreed was the formation of a small, compact council of ministers by October 30th which will include foreign and trade ministries.
